description: Check if a specific package version has known vulnerabilities. Requires an exact version: 'requests==2.31.0' for Python (the default ecosystem), or 'name@version' for other ecosystems (e.g., 'lodash@4.17.15' with ecosystem 'npm').

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem: "python" (default), "npm", "cargo", "gha", "vscode", "go", "ruby", "php", or "swift". Call `list_ecosystems` for name formats and examples.

name.description: The exact package name and version. For Python, use "==" (e.g., "requests==2.31.0"). For other ecosystems, use "name@version" (e.g., "lodash@4.17.15", "time@=0.1.43", "tj-actions/changed-files@v35").

name: is_vulnerable
